Method: Direct Explorer launch from prepared shortcut; actual accepted character ends timing. Normal OS cache retained; manual startup/typing delay is not subtracted.
StartupClockCalibration: OS creation FILETIME and accepted-input UTC with a 1ms guard; wall-clock step/error is not independently bounded. Not a calibrated first-possible-readiness measurement.

Observations.Reason: Actual focused accepted character; includes manual launch/activation and typing interval. No claim of first-possible readiness.
